# Will SSA accept this W-2 file?

> Free EFW2 checker for W-2 electronic wage files: finds records that are not 512 characters, invalid SSNs, RT totals that no longer match the wage lines, wrong RF counts and Social Security wage-base errors, and rebuilds the totals. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
